Name: bbBat's Return Compass
Author: batbadbat97
Description:
I didn’t like the idea of carrying a magic staff in my backpack that’s probably poking out, I’m more of a down-to-earth guy and a compass with a picture of loved one(that reminds you of home) is also more romantic, don’t you agree? 

Update:
Added a new redwood variety(choose "golden" or "wooden" in the config file); Added alternative description when the player isn't married.



[size=3]
Installation:
Download dependencies and drag the unzipped mod into your mod folder, and you're good to go! Enjoy![/size]
